# DevKit

DevKit is a free collection of private, browser-only developer tools.

## Tools
- JSON Formatter: format, validate, and minify JSON.
- JWT Decoder: inspect JWT headers and payloads locally.
- Regex Tester: test regular expressions and capture groups.
- Timestamp Converter: convert Unix timestamps and dates.
- Base64 Converter: encode and decode Base64 text.
- Text Diff Checker: compare two text files or blocks.
- Cron Job Parser: explain cron expressions.

All processing happens locally in the user's browser.
